8.3.2.2 FrTp_Shutdown
[SWS_FrTp_00148] Definition of API function FrTp_Shutdown ⌈
Service Name
FrTp_Shutdown
Syntax
void FrTp_Shutdown (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0x01
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This service closes all pending transport protocol connections by simply stopping operation,
frees all resources and stops the FrTp Module
Available via
FrTp.h
